content.short: Gimbalabs provides Cardano education, project-based learning programs, and open-source builder resources.
content.description: Gimbalabs is a Cardano education and builder-support initiative focused on project-based learning, open-source infrastructure, and hands-on community collaboration. It helps newcomers and experienced builders learn by working through practical programs such as Plutus and tokenomics courses while also contributing to open tooling and ecosystem projects. Gimbalabs sits at the intersection of education, experimentation, and open-source development for Cardano teams and contributors.
